verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs state you can offer customers all their preferred payment methods with a single integration, and that online payments cover cards, wallets, and local payment methods. A /paymentMethods endpoint is part of the standard flow. An independent implementer confirms offering 'every payment option under the sun', including bank-redirect methods like iDEAL and Sofort. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Apple Pay and BNPL support, and Google Pay documentation outside the agentic-commerce context.
